notes.title: V1.0.7 update
notes.notes:
1. Adjust the object distribution of novice maps and expansion maps to make them more concentrated and avoid novice meaningless map running
2. Add shortcut buttons for functional buttons
3. Modify the explanatory text of the phantom affixes, and the actual effect will not be affected

notes.title: V1.0.6 update
notes.notes: 1. Add mini map task markers to the first three maps to prevent novice players from running aimlessly

notes.title: V1.0.5 update
notes.notes:
1. Significantly reduce the number of affixes required for praying
2. When controlling the drop, do not control the material drop
3. Add hidden drops. When killing monsters, the dropped items have a probability of becoming full affix items. The lower the character level, the higher the probability
4. Adjust the two-handed sword holding node to make the two-handed sword movement more natural
5. Strengthen the affix 'Healing' to reduce beginner recovery pressure

notes.title: V1.0.4 update
notes.notes:
1. Control the number of drops to prevent a large number of drops in the future
2. Modify the prayer related data to be related to a single role, rather than sharing it with all roles
3. Modify the correlation between the success rate of praying and the total number of praying times
4. Add affixes such as "Giant Flow Arrow" and "Giant Fa Ball"

notes.title: V1.0.3 update
notes.notes:
1. Added props for prayer and affixes for sacrificial offerings, which can add specific affixes to props. At the same time, excess props also have uses, making the collection of affixes easier
2. Fix bugs with broken armor affixes and enhance the broken armor affixes, adding an additional 10% damage
3. Slightly increase the size of the collision body of the streamer barrage and reduce its movement speed to avoid the phenomenon of non collision
4. Increase achievements related to props and prayers
5. Add props to pray for beginner guidance
6. Adjust the novice task process and some rewards to avoid disrupting the task process

notes.title: V1.0.2 update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug where clicking on particle effects also redirects the cursor
2. Fixed a bug where releasing the mouse on the UI interface can cause continuous attacks during continuous attacks
3. Fixed a bug where viewing objects may trigger attacks
4. All map monsters will not upgrade by gaining experience points and affixes, reducing uncertainty during battles and difficulty for beginners
5. Increase the number of additional affixes for items rewarded by novice map and expansion map missions, further reducing the difficulty of novice affixes collection
6. Adjust the player's birth point position on the expansion map to be closer to the treasure chest position, to avoid beginners running aimlessly on the map

notes.title: V1.0.1 update
notes.notes:
1. Optimize the character turning experience
2. Optimize the character's continuous attack experience by long pressing and holding. Now, long pressing and attacking can move the mouse to change the character's direction and skill release points without using terminal attacks
3. Increase the "Expansion" map task rewards, reward items and materials with affixes, and further reduce the difficulty for beginners to collect affixes and edit equipment

notes.title: V1.0.0 update
notes.notes:
1. Add a talent system
2. New map "Mysterious Mine Cave"
3. Add props enhancement, which can increase the upper limit of props' affixes
4. New map "Yougu"
5. Add a new limit breakthrough that can increase the character level limit
6. Add affixes such as "Anger", "Calm Down", "Coagulation", "Dexterity", "Cruelty", "Prestige", "Stealing Lives", "Breaking Armor", "Drinking Blood", "Invisible", and "Extremely Invisible"
7. Added experience points for image challenge rewards
8. Increase the density of monsters in "Strange Land"
9. Increase the initial melee attack range of No. 0
10. Weakening the affix "Expansion"
11. Strengthen the affixes "Guarding", "Vitality", "Strong", "Rapid Response", and "Fast Track"
12. Adjust the level of stem quality to be the same as the legendary quality
13. "Phantom" affix adjusted to unique
14. "Auto Pick up Materials" affixes are adjusted to appear on any map
15. New icon in the start interface
16. Adjust the waiting time for the end of the game to 60 seconds
17. Reduce the birth point of players on the "Expansion" map, and avoid players running meaningless maps
18. Revised some task descriptions
19. Novice map tasks reward more affix props and materials, and novice affix collection is faster
20. After fixing the bug where the item quantity is 0 after consuming materials, the item does not disappear
21. Fixed a bug where the target selection for tracking the bullet screen remains unchanged after a melee attack
22. New Achievements
23. New summon following function
24. New module help interface
25. New talents: "Rapid Growth", "Bloodthirst", "Sharp Blade", "Bathing Fire", "Reproduction", "Irritability", "Eternal Life", and "Wind Wrath"

notes.title: V0.6.3 Update
notes.notes:
1. Greatly increase the drop rate of items in the expansion map treasure box

2. Increasing difficulty will increase the object's HP

3. Increased difficulty and task experience

4. Strengthened the affixes of "Dashan", "Perseverance", "Thorns", "Pursuing Victory", "Fast Attack", "Fire Rain Enhancement", "Flame Explosion Enhancement", "Mind Fire Rain", "Mind Flow Fire", "Mind Flame Explosion", and "Mind Fire Wall"

5. Weakened the affixes of "Qi Shou", "Night Crow", "Phantom", and "Command"

6. Reduce the maximum summon limit to 5

7. Fixed a bug where the attack speed bonus was invalid if it was higher than a certain value

8. Fixed a bug where fire rain enhanced collision detection was invalid

9. Fixed a bug in the Fire Rain enhancement range error

10. Fixed a bug where the HP display does not refresh when switching equipment to change the maximum HP limit

11. Fix the problem of summoning image stuck

12. The character's birth does not rotate in the novice figure to prevent the birth field from being blocked by the tree
